diag.recovery: Discarded legacy evidence is not replayed; affected plan steps must be re-proven by fresh, uniquely identified receipts. The authoritative CURRENT quarantine is owner_unproven (persisted in the snapshot; enumerate it with Reducer.quarantined_plans()). legacy_ownerless_plans is only a capped HISTORICAL SAMPLE of plans quarantined at migration (see legacy_ownerless_total); it is not updated by rebinds and must not be used to enumerate actionable plans. A plan in owner_unproven stays quarantined until an operator calls rebind_plan_owner(plan_id, incident_id, actor=..., reason=...) after preview_rebind(); targets must be open and a recorded owner candidate unless allow_non_candidate=True. An ordinary PLAN does not re-establish a lost owner.
